answers.name: Siamese
answers.fact: Their colour points are temperature-sensitive: cooler body parts grow darker fur.

answers.name: Persian
answers.fact: One of the oldest breeds, with a famously flat face.

answers.name: Maine Coon
answers.fact: The official state cat of Maine.

answers.name: Ragdoll
answers.fact: Named for going floppy when picked up.

answers.name: Sphynx
answers.fact: Hairless, but not bald: it's covered in fine peach fuzz.

answers.name: Bengal
answers.fact: Bred from domestic cats and the wild Asian leopard cat.

answers.name: Scottish Fold
answers.fact: Its folded ears come from a cartilage gene mutation.

answers.name: Munchkin
answers.fact: Short legs from a natural genetic mutation.

answers.name: British Shorthair
answers.fact: Often said to have inspired the Cheshire Cat.

answers.name: Russian Blue
answers.fact: Its silver-tipped coat seems to shimmer.

answers.name: Abyssinian
answers.fact: Each hair has bands of colour, called 'ticking'.

answers.name: Burmese
answers.fact: Western Burmese all descend from one cat, Wong Mau, brought to the US in 1930.

answers.name: Birman
answers.fact: The 'sacred cat of Burma', with pure white 'gloves' on its paws.

answers.name: Norwegian Forest Cat
answers.fact: Legend says they pulled the chariot of the Norse goddess Freyja.

answers.name: Siberian
answers.fact: Russia's national cat, with a thick triple coat.

answers.name: Devon Rex
answers.fact: Huge ears and curly fur: nicknamed the 'pixie cat'.

answers.name: Cornish Rex
answers.fact: Its coat has no guard hairs, just a soft wavy undercoat.

answers.name: Exotic Shorthair
answers.fact: Basically a short-haired Persian.

answers.name: American Shorthair
answers.fact: Descended from cats that sailed on early ships to catch rats.

answers.name: Himalayan
answers.fact: A Persian with Siamese colour points.

answers.name: Tonkinese
answers.fact: A cross between the Siamese and the Burmese.

answers.name: Oriental Shorthair
answers.fact: A Siamese body in hundreds of colours and patterns.

answers.name: Savannah
answers.fact: Part serval, a wild African cat.

answers.name: Manx
answers.fact: From the Isle of Man, and often born with no tail.

answers.name: Turkish Van
answers.fact: Nicknamed the 'swimming cat' for liking water.

answers.name: Turkish Angora
answers.fact: An ancient breed from Ankara that was once nearly lost.

answers.name: Ragamuffin
answers.fact: A fluffy cousin of the Ragdoll.

answers.name: Somali
answers.fact: A long-haired Abyssinian with a fox-like tail.

answers.name: Egyptian Mau
answers.fact: One of the few naturally spotted breeds, and among the fastest domestic cats.

answers.name: Chartreux
answers.fact: French blue-grey cats linked in legend to Carthusian monks.

answers.name: Balinese
answers.fact: A long-haired Siamese, named for its graceful, dancer-like movement.

answers.name: Bombay
answers.fact: Bred to look like a mini black panther.

answers.name: Japanese Bobtail
answers.fact: The model for the beckoning maneki-neko figurines.

answers.name: Selkirk Rex
answers.fact: Curly-coated, from a stray found in Montana in 1987.

answers.name: Ocicat
answers.fact: Looks wild, but it's all Siamese and Abyssinian.

answers.name: Singapura
answers.fact: One of the smallest cat breeds.

answers.name: Havana Brown
answers.fact: A chocolate-brown breed, possibly named after the cigar colour.

answers.name: Korat
answers.fact: A Thai good-luck cat, traditionally given to newlyweds.

answers.name: LaPerm
answers.fact: Its curly coat looks like a perm.

answers.name: Toyger
answers.fact: Bred to look like a toy tiger.

answers.name: Burmilla
answers.fact: Born from a 1981 accidental romance between a Burmese and a Chinchilla Persian.

answers.name: Nebelung
answers.fact: German for 'creature of the mist'.

answers.name: Snowshoe
answers.fact: White paws, as if it walked through snow.

answers.name: Pixie-bob
answers.fact: Bred to look like a bobcat; many have extra toes.

answers.name: American Curl
answers.fact: Its ears curl backwards.

answers.name: Peterbald
answers.fact: A hairless breed from St Petersburg.

answers.name: Lykoi
answers.fact: Its patchy coat earned it the name 'werewolf cat'.

answers.name: Chausie
answers.fact: Part jungle cat.

answers.name: Serengeti
answers.fact: Bred to look like a serval, without the wild genes.

answers.name: Khao Manee
answers.fact: A pure white Thai cat, often with odd-coloured eyes.

answers.name: Sokoke
answers.fact: A rare breed from a coastal forest in Kenya.

answers.name: Kurilian Bobtail
answers.fact: A bob-tailed cat from Russia's Kuril Islands.

answers.name: Australian Mist
answers.fact: The first cat breed developed in Australia, in the 1970s.
